thread:
Alex C.: incident-bot paging: p99 spike observed on streaming route /v1/stream (us-west1). Noticed concurrent drop in prefix-cache hit rate after the hash salt rollout at ~08:12 UTC. Paging oncall.

SRE Bot: [incident created] Sev2 - streaming-tail-latency. Runbook: streaming-tail -> investigate cache layer, routing, and recent deploys.

Oncall Pager: I'm on it. grabbing traces and redis metrics now. Any customer reports yet?

CS Rep: We got 2 customer support tickets about partial streaming responses (clients see long stalls ~10-20s) — both on prod us-west1. No data loss reported.

Maria G.: I'm checking deploy history. There was a small prefix-hash salt change rolled out 08:10 by infra-rollout job (auto). Could be related.

Devlin: pulling prefix-cache hit rate graph for the last 60m. p95 generation latency jumped from 180ms -> 1.2s, p99 to ~6s. Cache hit rate for prefix v3 down from 92% -> 38% around 08:12.

Alex C.: confirms correlation. Also seeing increased eviction churn on shard-7. Eviction ops spiked around the same time.

Tara Ops: are we seeing hotkey concentration or namespace rehash? I can run a quick keyspace heatmap.

Devlin: heatmap shows scatter — not single hotkey. Many keys moved across buckets after the salt delta. Looks like resharding mismatch between runtime and cache nodes (some nodes still using old hash).

Maria G.: oh — a canary of the new salt rolled earlier to 10% but rollout policy mis-evaluated and reached 60% due to autoscale controller bug. Rolling back now.

Oncall Pager: rollback started. Traffic being routed to old-hash pool. I'll watch p99 and hit rate.

SRE Bot: action logged: rollback-prefix-salt initiated by Maria G. at 08:23 UTC.

Devlin: adding a temporary routing rule: prefer nodes with prefix-hash=legacy for streaming routes to minimize cross-hash traffic. Command: ```rcli route set --service streaming --preference legacy --duration 15m```

Tara Ops: running that now. Also increasing cache TTLs for hot prefixes to avoid extra lookups while the cluster stabilizes: ```cachectl set-ttl --prefix v3 --ttl 300s --shard shard-*```

Alex C.: good. notifying customers: CS Rep please send templated note acknowledging degraded streaming experience and that mitigation is in progress.

CS Rep: sending now. message: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls in us-west1, mitigation underway; no data loss; ETA 30m."

Oncall Pager: metrics update 08:29: p95 is down to 320ms, p99 to 900ms, prefix hit rate up to 76%. Eviction ops still above baseline but trending down.

Devlin: logs show occasional KV lookup timeouts between runtime and cache nodes when hash mismatch occurs. Example log snippet: ```WARN runtime: prefix lookup mismatch: key=abc123 runtime-hash=0x1a cache-hash=0x9f, attempt=1```

Maria G.: checking orchestration: two cache nodes failed to pick updated config and reverted to new-hash while rest rolled back. Those nodes are being drained. I'm cordoning them.

Tara Ops: draining nodes shard-7a and shard-7b now. Using drain command: ```k8s cordon node/shard-7a && k8s drain node/shard-7a --ignore-daemonsets```

SRE Bot: note: customer-facing routing fallbacks enabled. Fallback policy will prefer legacy hash and fallback to local compute if cache miss > 2s.

Alex C.: can we add a temporary prefix-salt compatibility shim in the runtime to accept both hashes during the window?

Devlin: quick patch applied: runtime now checks both legacy and new salt buckets for reads; writes use legacy until rollout completes. Rolling via canary to two pods. ```git rev-parse --short```: 7a9f2de

Oncall Pager: p99 steady ~850ms. No new customer tickets in last 10m.

CS Rep: customers updated: they acknowledged and will monitor. No escalations yet.

Maria G.: post-rollback plan: run a gradual rollout with stronger preflight: verify config propagate to all cache nodes and wait 10m stable hit rate before moving to next cohort. Also add a controller check to avoid >20% surge without manual approval.

Tara Ops: follow-up tasks: 1) validate node configs across shards 2) add a circuit-breaker on autoscale for prefix-salt rollouts 3) create alert: prefix-hash-diff > 5% of nodes -> automatic rollback.

Devlin: collecting artifacts for handoff: traces, heatmaps, eviction logs, rcli commands used, and the canary git rev. Putting them into /incident/4456789123/artifacts.

Alex C.: handoff notes for next shift: state = mitigated (traffic on legacy), known cause = roll controller overshot canary causing mixed-hash cluster, impact = p99 streaming latency up to 6s for ~12m window, customer impact = intermittent stalls reported by two customers, current mitigation = rollback + routing preference + doubling TTLs + shim patch. Pending: permanent controller fix, alert added, dry-run rollback test.

Oncall Pager: I am taking follow-up. Will monitor next 2h and escalate if p99 > 1.2s or hit-rate < 85%.

SRE Bot: incident moved to "post-mitigated" state pending postmortem.

Maria G.: I'll draft a short postmortem and include timeline + PR refs + rollout gating changes. Will ping for review once initial draft ready.

Alex C.: thanks team. leave any outstanding items in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
